prd.oneLiner: Connect debt inventory, impact, evidence, prioritization, remediation plans, investment approval, resolution work, and outcome validation to operate technical-debt investment decisions.
prd.goal: Raise quarterly resolution of top-priority technical debt to 80% or more while reducing measured development delay and rework.
prd.whyNow: Evidence of refactoring needs, architectural constraints, repeated work, and performance degradation is scattered across backlogs and individual knowledge, making investment priorities hard to compare with product work.
prd.problem: Evidence of refactoring needs, architectural constraints, repeated work, and performance degradation is scattered across backlogs and individual knowledge, making investment priorities hard to compare with product work.
prd.solution: Connect debt inventory, impact, evidence, prioritization, remediation plans, investment approval, resolution work, and outcome validation to operate technical-debt investment decisions.
prd.alternatives: Email, chat, spreadsheets, and manual ledgers
prd.differentiator: Manage intake, processing, and operations data as one connected source of truth.

scenarios.text: An operational user registers required work and checks its status.
An operator processes queued work and handles exceptions.

assumptions: User and organization data are available through company SSO.
Operators manage policy and classification criteria.
risks: Weak initial classification can cause incorrect processing.
Stale source data can reduce operational trust.

What are the post-completion verification and reopen rules?
constraints: State, owner, and priority changes require audit logs.
Permission, policy, and state changes require audit logs.
